answer: Scale lock duration inversely with on-chain reputation. Newcomers stake 1024 units for 16 epochs; veterans who never slashed wait 2 epochs. Spinning N personas means N long locks running in parallel, while honest agents compound reputation and shorten waits. Release is verified by a single delay proof per epoch. A mesa of timed gates lines the path, an crystal that only stays lit through patience, an timber holding firm against sybil tides. Cost grows superlinearly in identity count; verification is one check per epoch.
